# Kirwan Clinic

> > Kirwan Clinic provides evidence-based psychology and neuropsychological assessment services in Floreat, WA, specializing in ADHD, autism, and mental health treatment.

Kirwan Clinic is a psychology practice in Floreat, Western Australia offering clinical psychology, neuropsychological assessment, and therapy services. The clinic specializes in neurodevelopmental assessments (ADHD and autism), mental health conditions, and evidence-based treatments including CBT and ACT, with Medicare rebates available.

## Key Topics

- ADHD Assessment
- Autism Assessment
- Clinical Psychology
- Neuropsychological Assessment
- CBT (Cognitive Behavioral Therapy)
- ACT (Acceptance and Commitment Therapy)
- Mental Health
- Depression
- Anxiety and Phobias
- OCD
- Individual Therapy
- Medicare Rebates
- Dr Andrew Sheridan
- Dr Alex Mladenovic
- Floreat, WA

- [Services](https://www.kirwanclinic.com.au/our-services): Comprehensive psychology services including therapy, assessments, CBT, cognitive support, and Medicare rebates

- [Fees](https://www.kirwanclinic.com.au/our-fees): Pricing information for therapy and assessments including ADHD and autism evaluations

## Clinical Team

- [Meet Our Team](https://www.kirwanclinic.com.au/meet-our-team): Team overview featuring clinical neuropsychologists at Kirwan Clinic
- [Dr Andrew Sheridan](https://www.kirwanclinic.com.au/dr-andrew-sheridan): Clinical Psychologist & Neuropsychologist, AHPRA registered specialist
- [Dr Alex Mladenovic](https://www.kirwanclinic.com.au/dr-alex-mladenovic): Clinical Neuropsychologist, UWA-trained specialist
- [Maira Vicente Braga](https://www.kirwanclinic.com.au/ms-maira-vicente-braga): Clinical Neuropsychologist Registrar, UWA-qualified
- [Sarah de la Harpe](https://www.kirwanclinic.com.au/sarah-de-la-harpe): Clinical Neuropsychologist Registrar specializing in child neurodevelopment
- [Sonja Syslo](https://www.kirwanclinic.com.au/sonja-syslo): Provisional Psychologist specializing in ADHD and autism assessment

## Neurodevelopmental Assessments

- [ADHD](https://www.kirwanclinic.com.au/attention-deficit-hyperactivity-disorder): ADHD overview: neurodevelopmental condition, causes, brain anatomy, and treatment information
- [Learning Difficulties](https://www.kirwanclinic.com.au/learning-difficulties): Learning difficulties including dyslexia, dyscalculia, neurological conditions, and assessment diagnosis
- [Intellectual Disability](https://www.kirwanclinic.com.au/intellectual-disability): Intellectual disability: cognitive functioning, adaptive behaviors, and syndrome types

## Mental Health Conditions

- [Depression](https://www.kirwanclinic.com.au/depression): Depression overview: symptoms, brain chemistry, and Major Depressive Disorder information
- [Anxiety and Phobias](https://www.kirwanclinic.com.au/anxiety-and-phobias): Anxiety and phobias: fear management, specific phobia types, and treatment approaches
- [OCD](https://www.kirwanclinic.com.au/obsessive-compulsive-disorder): OCD overview: symptoms, causes, intrusive thoughts, and treatment information
